finding: ⛔ THE RE-GRADE IS A NEGATIVE AND THE ROUTE STAYS PARKED. PMID 42660639 establishes ALK PROTEIN at D5F3 IHC 2+/3+ in 2 of 4 EMC cases and, by its own confirmation step, establishes that those cases LACK ALK gene rearrangement. A stain is not a fusion. It reports no activation, no dependency, no drug response, nothing on ROS1 and nothing about the model the 221-drug screen ran on, so it cannot attribute the hit — which is RT-ALK-HIT's whole question. ⭐ ARITHMETIC OVER THE PAPER'S OWN COUNTS IS WHAT DECIDES IT: 2/4 carries an exact 95% interval of 6.8%–93.2%, and EMC is not distinguishable from the rest of the cohort (32/115; Fisher two-sided p = 0.32), so the abstract's phrase 'a high overexpression rate' is a rank in a table and not an EMC-selective signal. The paper's headline is family-wide, 34/119 across 20 tumour types, and the largest positive denominator in it belongs to Ewing sarcoma. ⛔⛔ AND THE ITEM'S OWN PREMISE WAS FALSE, WHICH IS THE LARGER FINDING. AUT-PD-110 was queued on the reasoning that ALK and ROS1 have NO PROBE on either expression platform, making IHC 'exactly the protein-level modality the arrays could not supply'. research/modalities/emc-expression-panels.json — the artifact that OWNS those reads — has ALK readable on GPL6244 (one probe) and unreadable on GPL3290, ROS1 readable on BOTH, and the brigatinib target group at full 3/3 coverage on GPL6244 with a score emitted. The false sentence was hand-typed prose inside census_route_expression_grading.py, sitting in the same generated file as the per-gene table contradicting it, and in 20 days it propagated by copy into the route grade, the generated view, a downstream literature record and the ledger row that commissioned this cycle. ⚠ THE CORRECTION ENLARGES THE EVIDENCE BASE AND IMPROVES NOTHING: where ALK is readable it sits below the array median in EMC and level with the comparators. The route moves from 'we cannot see it' to 'we can see it on one platform and it is unremarkable there'. ⭐ What IHC genuinely adds is PROTEIN where the arrays give TRANSCRIPT — a real second modality, and a smaller gain than the item's framing claimed.
